claim_boundary: This is an implementation-only, fixed-water numerical preflight for auxiliary stationary electronic-continuum scalars. It does not use experimental solvation data and is not a source-bound preregistered control, a Route-2 public profile, a total solvation free-energy calculation, a force/PES certificate, a solvent model, or an accuracy result.
purpose: Distinguish the old rejected omegaB97M-V/IEFPCM/SWIG control from a separate numerical question: whether a no-training auxiliary SCF plus a self-consistent continuum can satisfy the strict translational-gradient diagnostic before any chemistry or nonpolar model is considered.

common_numerical_gate.name: translation_gradient_inf_hartree_per_bohr
common_numerical_gate.reason: A stationary scalar must be invariant under rigid translation to the declared numerical tolerance before it is allowed to contribute derivative evidence.

preflights.gas_electronic_functional: PySCF RKS PBE0/def2-TZVPD, atom-centred numerical grid level 4
preflights.continuum: PySCF ddCOSMO, epsilon=78.3553, default UFF*1.1 radii, Lebedev order 17, lmax=6
preflights.decision: Fails the fixed translational gate before any solvation or accuracy interpretation. The result does not authorize grid selection by later target errors or a retry of the old source-bound omegaB97M-V control.

preflights.gas_electronic_functional: PySCF RHF/def2-TZVPD with integral-exact Hartree-Fock terms
preflights.continuum: PySCF ddCOSMO, epsilon=78.3553, default UFF*1.1 radii, Lebedev order 17, lmax=6
preflights.decision: Passes only the implementation-level translation diagnostic. It establishes neither chemical accuracy nor a physical no-fit total solvent model: the default ddCOSMO cavity is still a discretized source-defined approximation and no cavitation, dispersion, standard-state, finite-k liquid response, force/PES, multi-solvent, or experimental gate has been supplied.

non_promotion_rules: Neither preflight may enter the FreeSolv12, MNSol, 11-solvent, confirmation, or blind accuracy leaderboard.
The passing RHF preflight may not be selected as a final method because it passed this one numerical gate.
No result may be combined with SMD-CDS, xTB COSMO components, a fitted cavity radius, or a target-derived correction.
The old omegaB97M-V/IEFPCM/SWIG source-bound failure remains frozen and is not modified or rerun by this artifact.
next_mathematical_requirement: A final V0 endpoint must supply a single physical solvent free-energy functional with source-bound nonpolar and standard-state terms, a smooth reciprocal continuum/cavity, and a stationary auxiliary electronic response. Only after those structural gates can the immutable twelve-record functional-group panel and subsequent multi-solvent/blind gates be run.
